name: plant-stake-labeler
description: Plant Stake Labeler is a fast, web-based greenhouse inventory labeling application for Label LIVE. Easily search Google Sheet plant inventory and print thermal plant stake labels with dynamic variable mappings, live label preview, and persistent print history logging. This template has the minimum variables defined, but you can find additional details on the template at the URLs listed below. https://github.com/helfrichmichael/plant-stake-labeler https://hub.docker.com/r/helfrichmichael/plant-stake-labeler
